```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(networkD3)
library(pins)
library(stringr)
library(lubridate)
```

## Load lead history data

Pinned via [https://connect.procogia.com/lead-sankey/](https://connect.procogia.com/leads-etl/)


```{r}
board <- board_connect()
leads <- board |> pin_read("leads")
lead_history <- board |> pin_read("lead_history")
```

NOTE: Data is currently a reduce sample.

```{r}
cat("leads:", nrow(leads), "\n")
cat("lead history records:", nrow(lead_history), "\n")

leads |> 
    mutate(`Year Created` = year(created_date)) |>
    count(`Year Created`) |> 
    gt::gt() 
```
## Sankey diagram

```{r}
# Create transitions from lead_history
transitions <- lead_history |>
    filter(! str_detect(stage_label, "SAL")) |>
  arrange(lead_id, ts) |>
  group_by(lead_id) |>
  mutate(next_stage = lead(stage_label)) |>
  filter(!is.na(next_stage)) |>
  count(stage_label, next_stage, name = "value") |>
  ungroup()

# Create nodes
nodes <- data.frame(
  name = unique(c(transitions$stage_label, transitions$next_stage)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) |>
  mutate(id = row_number() - 1)

# Create links with node IDs
links <- transitions |>
  left_join(nodes, by = c("stage_label" = "name")) |>
  rename(source = id) |>
  left_join(nodes, by = c("next_stage" = "name")) |>
  rename(target = id) |>
  select(source, target, value)

# Create sankey diagram
sankeyNetwork(Links = links, Nodes = nodes, Source = "source",
              Target = "target", Value = "value", NodeID = "name",
              fontSize = 12, nodeWidth = 30)
```

SAL... stages are excluded.

## Stage Transition Table



```{r}
transitions |>
  group_by(stage_label, next_stage) |> 
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = 'drop') |>
  arrange(desc(count)) |>
  gt::gt()
```
